name: ToonTone Cloud - Free Color Guessing Game
tagline: ToonTone Cloud is a free color guessing game you can play directly in your browser
description: ToonTone Cloud is a free color guessing game you can play directly in your browser. Memorize colors from illustration prompts, country flags, or pure color challenges, then recreate them with simple color sliders and get scored by how close your guess is. It includes daily challenges, practice modes, shareable results, local history, and leaderboards, with no account required.
